sentences.text:
Author: Nagesh Bheemapaka
Bench: Nagesh Bheemapaka
 Honourable Sri Justice Nagesh Bheemapaka
 Writ Petition No.12403 of 2025
Order:

The brief facts of the case as can be seen from the affidavit filed in support of the petition are that the petitioner was selected by Revenue and SC Corporation officials after due enquiry process after considering the relevant documents submitted by the petitioner for receiving Rs.9,90,000/- under Telangana Dalitha Bandhu Scheme as per G.O.Ms.No.6 dated 18.07.2021 and Memo No.1485/SCP.A1/2020.
The said scheme was introduced for the benefit of schedule caste people enabling them to invest the amount sanctioned by the government in any business or work of their choice.

Accordingly, the petitioner opened special bank Account through State Bank of India,
Huzurabad Branch with Account No. 40402579832.
Subsequently, the petitioner received a SMS alert stating that "Dear Customer, HOLD has been placed on your Acc XXXXX579832 for 9,90,000.00 for the reason DALITHA BANDHU-SBI".
Aggrieved by the same, the petitioner has approached the respondent officials for rederessal of his grievance.

The petitioner placed his grievance before "PRAJAVANI" vide registration Nos.KA049/E/2022/00410 NBK, J wp_12403_2025 dated 25.04.2022, KA049/E/2022/00565 dated 02.05.2022 and KA049/E/2022/00880 dated 06.06.2022.
2.
The petitioner has invoked jurisdiction of this Court as his grievances placed before Prajavani were not considered by the respondents.

3. In response to the above petition averments, the respondent No.4 filed counter and the brief averments of the said counter are that the petitioner registered his name for a separate Dalit Bandhu Unit while mentioning the ration card/food security card No.365340855620, wherein the names of his father, mother and sister were included.

The MPDO, MPP, Huzurabad reported that during the dalit bandhu survey in Kandugula Village, the petitioner name was not separated from the above said food security card number and thus, the cluster office placed the application of the petitioner on hold.

It is further submitted that as per clause 3 (a) of Govt. Memo No.1485/SCP.A1/2020 dated 25.08.2021 the amount shall be released to all SC families residing in Huzurabad constituency directly to the bank account of head of the family.
The ration card/food security card was taken into criteria to decide as a one family, as such, one unit is eligible per family household.

NBK, J wp_12403_2025 Accordingly, Smt. Rontala Suguna mother of the petitioner was sanctioned a (JCB) HITACHI, BACKHOE, Loader) along with two others @ Rs.9.90 lakhs unit price vide Rontala Suresh vs The State Of Telangana on 30 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45444620/
1 proceedings No.A4/35/DB/2021, dated 06.05.2022 issued by the District Collector/Chairman,
DSCSCDS Limited, Karimnagar.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
As only one unit is able to sanction under Dalith Bandu Scheme,
the petitioner is not entitled for any relief.

4. In response to the counter filed by the respondent No.4, the petitioner filed reply and mainly contended that his marriage was solemnized with Gurukuntla Vijaya on 15.06.2020 and they are residing as a distinct family unity completely unassociated with the prior ration card.

It is further contended that merely articulating defensive arguments such as the assertion of his contention to his parents' domicile despite his marriage and subsequent independent residence does not suffice and in fact he had informed the relevant authorities during the field inquiry of his situation.
5. Heard both sides and perused the record.
6.
It is an admitted fact that the petitioner along with his family members i.e., father, mother and sister were issued ration card/family safety card vide No.365340855620.
It is an NBK, J wp_12403_2025 admitted fact that by using the ration card i.e., family safety card vide No.365340855620 the petitioner registered his name for a separate Dalith Bandhu Unit.

It is also an admitted fact that Smt. Rontala Suguna, who is the mother of the petitioner was sanctioned a (JCB)
HITACHI, BACKHOE, Loader) along with two others @ Rs.9.90 lakhs unit price vide proceedings No.A4/35/DB/2021, dated 06.05.2022 issued by the District Collector/Chairman, DSCSCDS Limited, Karimnagar by mentioning the same ration card/family safety card vide No.365340855620, which was used by the petitioner for registration.

7. The contention of the petitioner is that he got married on 15.06.2020 and alleged to have been staying separately and distinctly unassociated with his family members, as such, he is entitled for benefits of Dalith Bandhu.
However, it is pertinent to note that the petitioner failed to detach his name from the ration card/family safety card vide No.365340855620.

As per clause 3 (a) of Govt.
Memo No.1485/SCP.A1/2020 dated 25.08.2021 the amount shall be released to all SC families residing in Huzurabad constituency directly to the bank account of head of the family.
The mother of the petitioner was NBK, J wp_12403_2025 sanctioned a JCB worth of Rs.9,90,000/- in the year 2022.
Though the petitioner was claiming to be living away from his family, he failed to detach his name from the ration card of his family members.

Since he has not detached himself from his joint family, it draws an adverse inference against the petitioner that he is still continuing with his family as part of one unit.
8.
It is to be seen that as per the guidelines of Dalith Bandhu Scheme the amount shall be released directly to the bank account of head of the family.
Admittedly the petitioner is not the head of his family and in fact his mother is the head of the said family after the demise of father of the petitioner.
Accordingly, the respondent officials have rightly sanctioned the amount in favour of the mother of the petitioner being head of the family.

In such circumstances, the petitioner cannot claim the benefits under Dalith Bandhu Scheme again in his independent capacity, more particularly, by using the same ration card that was used by his mother.

Merely because the petitioner got married and living separately in a rented house, it does not entitle him to receive the benefits under Dalith Bandhu Scheme having received the same benefit under the same scheme already being part of his Rontala Suresh vs The State Of Telangana on 30 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45444620/
2 joint family.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The respondents NBK, J wp_12403_2025 have categorically mentioned in their counter that petitioner and his parents including his sister, has been treated as one unit taking food security card as criteria.
It is not even the case of the petitioner that he is having separate ration card/food safety card.

9. In view of the above facts and circumstances, viewing from any angle, this Court is of the considered opinion that the petitioner failed to establish any of the grounds to entitle him to receive the benefits of Dalith Bandhu independently and distinctly having received the same benefit under the scheme being part of his joint family.
10. In view of the above submission, the Writ Petition is dismissed.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, the miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.

_ _ _ JUSTICE NAGESH BHEEMAPAKA Date:
